name: Modi Explaining Charkha to Trump and Melania
visual_description: Narendra Modi animatedly explains a traditional spinning wheel (charkha) to Melania Trump and a visibly bored Donald Trump.
usage_context: Used to depict passionately explaining a complex or mundane topic to completely uninterested or baffled listeners.
